import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Stash and pull
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git stash && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("Pull:", stdout.read().decode())
# Also fix tsconfig (was modified locally)
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && sed -i 's/moduleResolution.*bundler/moduleResolution: NodeNext/' server/tsconfig.json")
# Also add type module to root
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cd /opt/areloria && sed -i "/private.*true/a\\  \\"type\\": \\"module\\"," package.json')
# Build
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm --filter @wasd/server build 2>&1 | tail -8")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check dist exists
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js 2>&1")
print("\nDist:", stdout.read().decode())
# Run
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && timeout 8 node server/dist/index.js 2>&1 || true")
print("\n=== Run ===")
print(stdout.read().decode()[:500])
client.close()
EOF
